summary: Layer 3 second pass over the leftover candidates of chapters 14 to 18 (late firing). 64 records added: chapter 14 c14-26 to c14-68 (43), chapter 15 c15-16 to c15-18 (3), chapter 16 c16-21 and c16-22 (2), chapter 17 c17-21 to c17-23 (3), chapter 18 c18-23 to c18-35 (13); none dropped in review. Every record was independently reviewed and scored blind by two raters; c14-61 and c18-30 went to a third rater. Review lowered or re-staged 14 drafts and raised 6 (c14-43, c14-46, c14-56, c14-61, c15-17, c16-22); c14-57 moved to blocked on the August 2025 vacatur of the contraceptive exemption rules. Reverse cross-references were added on 48 existing records. The counted set is now 590. Set aside as not publicly checkable: chapter 14 testing role, data modernization, ACYF and ACL review items, childcare and doula funding, IHS and rural health postures, collusion investigations, Secretary statements and ASPR and stockpile reviews; chapter 17 crime plans, personnel actions and prosecution priorities; chapter 18 the persuader rule contingency. About 147 of 190 searches used (researchers 116, reviewers 31, raters 0).
title: Layer 3 second pass: chapters 14 to 18 leftovers (late firing)
